label.zh: 维度锁即将失稳：续期或放手
label.en: Dimensional Lock destabilizing: renew or let go

note.zh: 单事件通知：花 1000 星界丝缕延长锁定（要求锁可续期），或“由它去吧”——锁到期后只能由科研船重新建立。
note.en: A single-event notice: spend 1000 astral threads to renew the lock (it must be renewable), or “Let it go” — after expiry it must be re-established with a Science Ship.

notes.zh: 这是“维度锁”星界行动（action_dimensional_lock，astral_planes_actions.txt:578，花费 1000 星界丝缕，锁定时长 3600 天，到期前 30 天提醒，common/defines/00_defines.txt:588-592）的到期通知事件，由 on_action on_dimensional_lock_expired 触发（“Fired when a bypass Dimensional Lock expires”，00_on_actions.txt:5129-5135），事件上下文是那个旁路。它不是裂隙探索的一部分，也没有后续事件。事件文字写的是“正在失稳”，选项 b 说“将会过期”，与 on_action 的注释措辞略有出入；脚本没有给出更多信息。
notes.en: This is the expiry notice of the “Dimensional Lock” astral action (action_dimensional_lock, astral_planes_actions.txt:578, cost 1000 astral threads, duration 3600 days, warning 30 days before; common/defines/00_defines.txt:588-592). It is fired by the on_action on_dimensional_lock_expired (“Fired when a bypass Dimensional Lock expires”, 00_on_actions.txt:5129-5135), with the bypass as scope. It is not part of a rift exploration and has no follow-up event. The event text says “destabilizing” and option b says “will expire”, slightly different from the on_action comment; the script gives no more detail.

scope.zh: 已核对 astral_planes.1030、维度锁行动定义与相关 defines。
scope.en: Checked astral_planes.1030, the Dimensional Lock action definition and the related defines.

uncertain: 到期前 30 天提醒与 on_dimensional_lock_expired 的确切先后在脚本中不可见。 / The exact order of the 30-day warning and on_dimensional_lock_expired is not visible in script.
